explanation: The generic harness reporting fallback labels any additional ID as an A02 reader control. The final static function actually checks its prebound preservation plan: nine original full-function ASTs, seven actual loader IDs without execution or skips, fifteen protected files, and fifteen unique ordered JS segments. It does not execute either reader-race control.

ast_representation.preservation_control: SHA-256 of UTF-8 ast.dump(function_node, annotate_fields=True, include_attributes=False)
ast_representation.comparison_rule: Compare each representation only with its own frozen oracle; these different hash representations are not expected to equal each other.
